claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b088] This file covers ONLY lines 215-343 of results/ci-metadata-registry.md; sibling batches cover lines 1-172 (b086) and 173-214 (b087). Batch-level scope decisions: dates and timestamps (2026-04-20, 2026-04-16/17), git commit hashes and blob ids, session numbers, version strings, the "ISO 8601" standard name, sidecar schema key names, and numbers that appear only inside file paths or class names (`era2`, `e47-v1-vs-v2`, `h8-v2`, `h12-v2`, `phase3a`, `phase2a/b/c/d`, `tile-size-30m`, `prompt-engineering-20m`, `55maps-generalisation`) are out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5. The phrase "A one-line metadata block" at line 339 is treated as a rhetorical descriptor rather than a quantitative claim; the proposed `"_metadata"` patch at lines 339-341 contains no numeric literals. § Provenance chains (lines 318-333) carries no numeric claim. IMPORTANT ANCHORING NOTE for this batch: the § Summary counts class totals (lines 222-251) are tallies over the registry TABLE that occupies lines 1-214 of this same markdown document; instrument rule 2 forbids anchoring prose to prose, so every class-count value in those claims takes method `anchor-unknown` with the registry table named here — triage must chase the tallied rows to artefacts. This first value ("thousands") is a qualitative magnitude, not a figure; it is recorded with value_parsed null and flagged as doubtful inclusion. The directory-level sidecar records the count as `coverage_file_count_approximate`.
